identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Oral Ixazomib Maintenance Therapy in Participants With Newly Diagnosed Multiple Myeloma (NDMM) Not Treated With Stem Cell Transplantation (SCT)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 3, Randomized, Placebo-Controlled, Double-Blind Study of Oral Ixazomib Maintenance Therapy After Initial Therapy in Patients With Newly Diagnosed Multiple Myeloma Not Treated With Stem Cell Transplantation

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Ixazomib placebo-matching capsule, orally, once on Days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle from Cycles 1 through 26.

armGroups.label: Ixazomib
armGroups.description: Ixazomib 3 mg, capsule, orally, once on Days 1, 8, and 15 of each 28-day cycle from Cycles 1 to 4 that may have been escalated to 4 mg thereafter up to Cycle 26.
